sources.stones: recipes/grid/lathbundles.json: laths float even soaked (400 kg/m³ dry, about a third more with the water they take up: itemtypes/resource/lath.json), so a bundle is held down by stones laid on it, as soaked timber was. The game gives a stone no mass, so a stone's weight under water is set by the largest bundle: one full stack of vanilla's stones (64) holds 32 wet laths of 5 m. A bundle's buoyancy goes with its laths' length, and so do its stones: 64 × length / 5, rounded (26, 38, 51, 64). Every stone comes back when the bundle is untied
sources.transitionableProps: A soaked bundle out of the water dries as its laths do (itemtypes/resource/lath.json)
